The verdict is **fix**: the redesign proposal (`doc/redesign.md`) and the 400 px phone screenshots were never made. The audit links to `redesign.md` four times, and each link is a 404.

The report is at `review/report.md` in the refine-audit task folder. The other fixes in it:
- **Audit doc corrupted:** the uncommitted copy of `audit-2026-10-15.md` has a stray backtick at the start and end of every line, and section 3b escapes all its backticks, so the inline code would show up broken.
- **Not linked:** `ext/Refine/readme.md` doesn't link the new docs, so the audit can't be reached from the site.
- **Cleaner page unproven:** `/framework/ext/Refine/cleaner/` shows a 404 in every screenshot. That's likely because the screenshots load the main site rather than this branch, so it still needs checking before it merges.
- **Wrong link target:** the "Cleaner" links in `Prompt.js` and `RefineSystem.js` point at `engine.js`, but the audit says they should go to the new class page.

The bug work itself holds up: the cause of the lost "Can you hear me?" is reproduced in code, and the leaked `S1.` markers and the clipped text box are fixed. I made no code edits.
